title: TextElementProps
description: The props of a text element (epic Tale Studio R4): plain Unicode text, never HTML or Markdown, wrapped inside the element's box. A line feed starts a new line. Every style prop is optional (an additive change); one left out takes its default from the contract (`DEFAULT_TEXT_STYLE`), which is how text looked before styling. Styles are enumerated or range-checked values, never CSS text (AD-15).

font.description: Where the font comes from: a system stack of the font registry, the project theme's font, or a font-family list the host page loads (the theme's font-list rules, `isFontFamily`). Project fonts join later as another source.

fallback.description: The system stack used until, or when, the font is not available.

size.description: The font size as a fraction of the canvas height.

align.description: Where lines sit in the box; `start` and `end` follow the text direction.

direction.description: The text direction: `auto` takes it from the first strong character.

lineHeight.description: The line height as a multiple of the font size.

background.description: Behind the text: nothing, a solid box filling the element, or a highlight behind each line.

backgroundColor.description: The box or highlight colour as #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA.
